messages:
ashok: Quick sync — planning v2.15 rollout next Friday. Need to lock the version bump, changelog, and regional canary windows. TL;DR: US primary, EU follow, APAC final (low traffic).

rachel: Question — what's our merge cutoff? Marketing demo is Friday 18:00 UTC, want to avoid any risky deploys during that.

ashok: Proposing cutoffs: merge to release branch by Thu 22:00 UTC; final freeze Fri 12:00 UTC (no migrations after this). Canary windows (first pass):
- US: 2026-04-02T15:00Z (30m)
- EU: 2026-04-02T19:00Z (30m)
- APAC: 2026-04-03T02:00Z (45m)

kevin: +1 but we need to slot DB work. Any long-running migrations? @maria can you confirm?

maria: Two migrations: one ~10m atomic add-column (safe) and a 20m backfill we can run async. Recommend running the backfill during APAC ramp (low traffic). I'll add details to the PR.

kevin: Cool. Backout plan? If canary fails we rollback to v2.14 and run healthchecks, right?

ashok: Yes — rollback on errors >5% or latency >2x baseline in canary. Also automatic fallback to smaller model variant on OOMs. Documented in runbook.

deploy-bot: CI ✅ All checks passed for PR #2382 (v2.15-bump). Deployment window pending final approvals.

rachel: Changelog nudge: only put things under "breaking changes" if they actually break public APIs. Otherwise use "misc fixes / infra". Ping me when changelog is updated.

maria: Pushed PR update with migrations section + proposed schedule. ping @kevin for CR.

kevin: Reviewing now, will approve by EOD. Suggest staggering EU by 10–15m after US so we can validate metrics.

ashok: Good call. Updated schedule suggestion:
- US: 15:00Z (30m)
- EU: 15:40Z (30m)
- APAC: 02:00Z (45m, backfill runs)
Also: Dedicated customers do NOT auto-upgrade — manual rollout only.

sre-oncall: I'll run the smoke checks and watch traces during canaries. Please add me to the runbook steps and the incident Slack channel. :white_check_mark:

rachel: Final logistics: create branch `release/v2.15`, bump versions in package.json and server image tag, and link the changelog entry in the PR. I'll finalize the changelog after PR merge.

ashok: Thanks — links: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repos/pull/2382 and rollout doc https://internal/docs/releases/v2.15. Snippet of the schedule I added to the doc:
```yaml
canaries:
  us:
    start: "2026-04-02T15:00Z"
    duration: "30m"
  eu:
    start: "2026-04-02T15:40Z"
    duration: "30m"
  apac:
    start: "2026-04-03T02:00Z"
    duration: "45m"
migrations:
  backfill_window: "apac_during_canary"
  atomic_migration: "thu_22_utc"
```

kevin: LGTM — approving now. Will be on standby for rollback if needed. See everyone Friday.
